changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO permissions (id, created_at, created_by, deleted, code, description) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), now(), 'system', false, 'admin.documents.review', 'Approve or reject the allocation conditions developers write, before a letter may use them.'); INSERT INTO role_permissions (id, created_at, created_by, deleted, role_id, permission_id) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), now(), 'system', false, r.id, p.id FROM roles r, permissions p WHERE p.code = 'admin.documents.review' AND r.code IN ('super_admin', 'compliance_officer');
